snapshot.source_notes: NO FULLY OFFICIAL LGD DISTRICT EXPORT WAS REACHABLE. LGD's own district listings (globalviewdistrictforcitizen.do, downloadDirectory.do, districtWiseDetailReport.do) are all behind an image CAPTCHA, which was not bypassed. District names and LGD codes therefore come from the Government of India Open Government Data resource 'Local Government Directory (LGD) - Districts' (uuid 37231365-78ba-44d5-ac22-3deec40b9197, publisher: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, reference_url https://lgdirectory.gov.in/), retrieved 2026-09-23. That export is STALE: it is missing 11 districts created between Feb 2024 and Dec 2025, still carries 9 Rajasthan districts cancelled in Dec 2024/Jan 2025 and 1 Delhi district removed in Dec 2025, lists 2 Puducherry administrative units as districts, and carries at least one stale spelling (Ahmednagar, now Ahilyanagar). The state/UT list and the authoritative per-state district counts come from LGD itself at https://lgdirectory.gov.in/reportonStatewiseEntityDetails.do, the only LGD report page that renders without a CAPTCHA; it reports 36 states/UTs and 784 districts. The two sources agree exactly on all 36 state/UT codes and names. Where they disagreed on district counts (9 states/UTs), each case was resolved against state gazettes and official state portals, and the corrections are recorded per district. Records added from those state sources have NO LGD code and carry a PENDING-LGD- placeholder. Count agreement does NOT prove name currency. Read docs/district-registry-reconciliation.md before treating any record as final.
